_note: Which path each module's Jev decisions take. Checked in on purpose: routing is a project decision, not a secret, so it belongs somewhere visible rather than in .env. Environment variables still win over this file, for a one-off run.

jev_data_policy._no_backend: This module makes no Jev calls at all: data classification is deterministic and local, so it has no path to choose. It reads this file only for data_policy below.

_backends.native: the Jev API at www.jevai.org, with JEV_API_KEY
_backends.openrouter: the Jev model ~typesafe/jev-latest on OpenRouter, with OPENROUTER_API_KEY

_precedence: argument > MODULE_<NAME> env > JEV_<NAME> env > this file's modules.<module> > this file's top level > built-in default
_no_secrets: An api_key here would be committed to git, so it is refused. Keys live in .env.
